text_original: Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Natural-language / LLM voice assistant — standard: Voice Recognition System standard (BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant per BMW US press release). Notes: KBB spec table lists 'Voice Recognition System' as Standard on 530i. The 2023 US press release mentions voice commands to the BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant. No source states an LLM-based assistant for the US G60.

Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Phone-as-key / digital key — unknown: Phone-as-key not stated; 'Proximity Sensing Keyless Entry' listed as standard. Notes: Difference to DE: keyless proximity entry is standard on the US 530i but only in Travel Paket 7LK in Germany. BMW Digital Key / Digital Key Plus (UWB) not mentioned in any fetched US source.
